scripts.generate: mkdir -p build && cp ../../spec/openapi.json ./build/openapi.json && python3 ../../.github/scripts/normalize_spec.py ./build/openapi.json && openapi-python-client generate --path ./build/openapi.json --output-path ./ --overwrite --config config.yaml --custom-template-path templates && python3 scripts/render_manifest.py && poetry version "$(tr -d ' \n' < version.txt)"
